images.title: The One Who Stayed
images.prompt: Stylised cinematic 3D animated film still, fantasy world inside a living body, soft wet translucent tissue with subsurface scattering, dry chalky ivory bone, no gore, no wounds. Inside a large cave of soft blue marrow, an old elder seen from behind in the upper left: the same slender simplified Blue-Born build grown thin and stooped, pale mineral blue skin, large readable hands, a long wrap of pale woven fibre. One hand is raised to cup a small warm marrow lamp set in the wall, dimming it; the lamps further along are already low.
